Accelerometer impact detection → camera verification → multi-channel alert.

When an accelerometer impact event is reported by the sensor subsystem,

Scheduled periodic patrol that reads accelerometer data and triggers
fall detection if anomaly is found.

## When to use
When user says "start patrol", "开始巡检", "定时巡检",

   "Run fall-patrol check: read accelerometer data, if abnormal

2. Each time the cron job fires:
   a. run_shell to read accelerometer / IMU sensor data
      (e.g. cat /dev/sensor/accel0 or platform-specific command)
   b. Analyze sensor reading:
      - If sudden impact / free-fall / abnormal g-force detected:

      - If normal (steady gravity ~9.8 m/s², no spikes):
        → write_file append timestamp to /data/agent/patrol.log
        e.g. "[2026-07-26 15:00] patrol OK — accelerometer normal"

- You MUST execute tools and respond with results. Do NOT output this template.
